g.text: Each pair uses its own shared valid footprint and six April 2022 background observations.
Envelope = April mean ± 2 sample standard deviations, with the lower limit clipped to zero.
The two values for 17–20 June reflect different comparison footprints.
22–25 June qualified. Two consecutive qualifying checkpoints were unconfirmed through 25 June.
The criterion assesses return of the optical classification metric to its pre-flood range.
